hooks.command: if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/xtask/hooks/pre-tool-use.sh" ]; then sh "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/xtask/hooks/pre-tool-use.sh"; else echo "xtask hook: $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR has no xtask/hooks/pre-tool-use.sh; the git guard is off" >&2; fi

if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/xtask/Cargo.toml" ]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && cargo xtask hook stop 1>&2 || { echo 'cargo xtask check failed'; exit 2; }; else echo "xtask hook: $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR has no xtask; no checks run" >&2; fi
